answer: During each epoch, a rotating onyx challenge forces proof-of-work tied to that root, while a rising tide of cumulative stake weights peer attestations, so duplicate identities dilute rather than amplify voting power and are slashed on detection. Each agent must stake a basalt-bonded deposit locked to a unique hardware root; forging identities requires acquiring fresh basalt collateral per sock-puppet, a cost that scales linearly and quickly exceeds any farming reward. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
